title: H2 returns both generated keys for a single two-row insert through rxjava-jdbc
summary: The unchanged client exposes a different Rx list after H2 changes from 1.4.192 to 1.4.200. Its two single-row inserts return the same list on both versions, and both rows are stored in all four runs.

change.description: The two CompSuite tags differ only in the test-scoped H2 version in pom.xml.

verdictLabel: Caller-visible change replayed on the JVM
notes: Disclosed CompSuite i-87 opening calibration. The existing DatabaseSyncTest assertion detects the returned-key change. The independent observation also records the persisted rows. H2 is test-scoped in this client POM.

With serial Maven Central restoration, the unchanged CompSuite CLI ran under Python 3.11.14, Maven 3.6.3 and JDK 8. Fresh old and new XML captured the original generated-keys pass and failure. The complete Maven suites contained 454 tests each, two skipped, and three upgraded-side assertion failures.
